steps.text: Grind coffee beans using the electric coffee grinder
steps.label: grind beans

steps.text: Pour ground coffee into the metal V60 filter
steps.label: fill v60 filter

steps.text: Pour water into the V60. Pour enough hot water to soak all the coffee grounds, then wait until most water is filtered through.
steps.label: bloom grounds

steps.text: Slowly pour over the remaining water over the coffee, making small circles. Stop when the water is 3/4 of the way or 2 cm from the top.
steps.label: pour over coffee

steps.text: Wait for it to drain, allowing the coffee to cool down a little.
steps.label: let coffee drip
